controls.tile_metres/edge_metres: Physical repeat in U/V; fine pieces crop at the same density.
controls.colour: Unlit sRGB host colour, without photographed shadows.
controls.roughness: Dry versus fused surface response; no emission.
controls.relief_m: Normal-map microrelief only; no structural scar or collision change.
controls.courses/columns: Course layout that repeats on whole metre module boundaries.
controls.fossils: Uneven partial and whole shell impressions per 2 m repeat.
controls.opacity: Fixed glass visibility; alpha blend only on the pane, opaque frame.
controls.frame_width_m/muntin_width_m/pane_depth_: Existing native fixed-window dimensions, read-only reference.

families.name: Dressed stone
families.purpose: Regular dressed courses, restrained chipped bedding and tool grain.

families.name: Rough fieldstone
families.purpose: Varied dry contacts, rounded irregular stones and lichen remnants; low forms only.

families.name: Layered slate
families.purpose: Cleaved blue-grey faces and thin chipped edge laminations.

families.name: Fossil shellstone
families.purpose: Warm cut rock with irregular broken shell fragments and occasional whole impressions.

families.name: Fired rustclay
families.purpose: Staggered red-brown fired courses, firing patches and narrow pale joints.

families.name: Fused basalt
families.purpose: Broken glossy fused islands in a heavy matte body; no burning cracks.

families.name: Smoky fixed glass
families.purpose: Smoky streaks, modest normal distortion and a complete opaque integral mineral frame.

families.name: Charcoal fuel
families.purpose: Angular black porous chunks, retained wood fissures and light ash; fuel only.
